claims.explanation: The norm of the first vector is not \(\sqrt{65}\). It is \(\sqrt{4^2+4^2+7^2}=\sqrt{81}=9\), so the denominator should be \(9\sqrt{18}\). Correctly, \(\cos\theta=27/(9\sqrt{18})=1/\sqrt2\), giving \(\theta=45^\circ\).
Even using the preceding erroneous value \(\cos\theta=27/\sqrt{1170}\), the arccosine is approximately \(37.88^\circ\), not \(39.42^\circ\). With the corrected denominator, the angle is \(45^\circ\).
